slides.title: Bored? *Roll a question.*
slides.sub: Roll a real die, or just pick a number. Silly answers only.

slides.title: Would you still love me *if I was a worm?*
If I were a vegetable, *which one* would I be?
What would our band name be *if we were a band?*
If we swapped bodies for a day, *what’s the first thing* you’d do?
Which *cartoon character* am I most like?
If we pulled off a heist, *what’s my role?*
Save this *for the next boring evening.*
slides.sub: Roll twice if the answer was too short.
